The term can simply mean age or antiquity, but in Paul's theological framework it suggests obsolescence—the old covenant arrangement that has been superseded. The word evokes worn-out garments, outdated methods, or past eras. It's not merely temporal age but functional obsolescence that carries the emphasis."

  Sense 1: ""
    Enriched: Romans 7:6 contrasts two modes of service: we serve 'in newness of the Spirit and not in oldness of the letter.' The Spirit brings fresh vitality where the letter brought only antiquated condemnation.
